basic_info.description: Charming Noe Valley Gem - First Time on the Market in Over 50 Years! This rare opportunity in the heart of Noe Valley is a dream come true for those looking to make their mark in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. Offered for the first time in over 50 years, this home boasts great bones and tons of potential, ready for your creative touch and vision. With its prime location on Diamond and Clipper, you'll be just a short walk from the best shops, cafes, parks and restaurants Noe Valley has to offer. Whether you're enjoying a leisurely stroll to your favorite local spots or transforming this house into your forever home, the possibilities are endless. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Noe Valley history and create something truly special. Come see it today!
